selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq (STAR 2.7.8a + RSEM 1.3.2 expected counts, GENCODE M25/mm10), skeletal muscle (tibialis anterior per FIG1C legend)
selected.sample_inclusion: 2x2 factorial, n = 4 per group, 16 samples, all deposited (FIG1C: n = 4)
selected.primary_estimand: Effect of 4 weeks of treadmill exercise training on skeletal-muscle gene expression in WT mice (trained vs untrained), and the same training effect in CHCHD4 Tg mice, whose comparison shows which training responses depend on CHCHD4 downregulation (S2.7.p5, Tables S4 and S5)
planned_contrasts: WT trained vs WT untrained (S2.7.p5; Table S4 by context; paper DEG count not available, supplementary table not in hand)
CHCHD4 Tg trained vs Tg untrained (S2.7.p5; Table S5 by context; count not available)
Tg vs WT within untrained and within trained (S2.1.p2, FIG1C volcano, Tables S1-S3) - genotype contrasts, not exercise effects; not run here

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.3.8.p1 states no DEG cutoff; FIG1C draws a p = 0.01 display line on the Tg/WT volcano only

selected.paper_results: Training increased mt-Nd3, Atp1a3, Rrad, Plac8, Cidea and Myh7 in WT but not Tg (S2.7.p5, S2.1.p2); GO of changed genes: muscle contraction terms (FIG S4B)

decisions.reason: S2.1.p2 describes RNA-seq of skeletal muscle from Tg and WT mice with or without exercise training (four groups). S2.7.p5 states exercise training increased MT-ND3/ATP1A3/RRAD/PLAC8/CIDEA in WT but not Tg (Tables S4 and S5), i.e. within-genotype trained-vs-untrained comparisons. S4.3.8.p1: STAR/RSEM expected counts, edgeR exactTest. FIG1C: n = 4, tibialis anterior. No DEG significance rule is stated; the p = 0.01 line is a volcano display line for Tg/WT.

checks: S4.1.3.p1 and key resources table name GEO GSE245760
GEO contact Paul M. Hwang (NHLBI) matches the authors' institute and S4.3.8.p1 NHLBI core
16 samples = 2 genotypes x 2 training states x 4, matching FIG1C n = 4
data_processing text (STAR 2.7.8a, GENCODE M25, RSEM 1.3.2) matches S4.3.8.p1 verbatim
Chchd4 counts ~2.7-fold higher in B/D (Tg) columns than A/C (WT), confirming genotype labels

decisions.reason: Paper names GSE245760 as its RNA-seq deposit; processing and design match; Tg labels confirmed by Chchd4 expression.

Matrix columns are '<A1..D4>.Aligned.toTranscriptome.out.bam.rsem.genes.results'; the GEO description field holds A1..D4 exactly (A = exercised WT, B = exercised Tg, C = unexercised WT, D = unexercised Tg per titles). Exact key match after stripping the suffix.

File is the RSEM genes.results expected_count table (87.5% integer, non-integer remainder, column sums 41-62 M consistent with read counts, not TPM/FPKM). data_processing: 'expected counts were quantified using RSEM'. The paper ran edgeR on these expected counts (S4.3.8.p1). Rows renamed to gene symbols by prep_matrix.py without changing values.

2x2 factorial with independent animals. The paper's exercise comparisons are trained vs untrained within WT and within Tg, each by pairwise exactTest. Genotype is a stratum so comparisons never cross genotype.
Independent mice per group, no batch, lane or pairing information in GEO or the paper; all male (S4.2.1.p1). No covariate added.

paper_route.reason: the repository's edgeR executor (tools/edger_tools.py) implements only the GLM quasi-likelihood test; no exactTest executor exists

deviations: edgeR glmQLFTest instead of exactTest on the same 8-sample two-group comparison
RSEM expected counts rounded to integers before edgeR (paper presumably passed them to edgeR as is; edgeR accepts non-integer counts)
no low-count filter (paper states none; executor drops all-zero genes only)

decisions.reason: Paper used edgeR on RSEM expected counts. exactTest is unavailable, so the closest validated route is edgeR TMM + QL F-test per pairwise comparison (8 samples, the comparison's own arms). Rounding is documented. DESeq2 per stratum runs as a sensitivity analysis.

selected.deviation_note: The paper states no DEG rule; applied BH padj < 0.05 (workflow default). Audit p < 0.01 mirrors the FIG1C volcano display line, which the paper drew for the Tg/WT plot only.

decisions.reason: S4.3.8.p1 gives no cutoff; FIG1C shows p = 0.01 as a display line.
Paper's WT training effect (Table S4), pairwise edgeR on the 8 WT samples
Paper's Tg training effect (Table S5), pairwise edgeR on the 8 Tg samples
Method sensitivity for the primary contrast
